notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Hello everybody!
We have found some time and we bring you the 1.1 update, which includes:


Updated the project to Unity 2021.
Added a loading screen that makes the transition to the game less abrupt.
Changed some parameters of the monster and the protagonist to balance the difficulty.
Slightly increased the intensity of the flashlight.
Fixed a bug when picking up a candy that caused the raycast to skip a collision and reposition a random object in the environment.
Fixed a bug that caused a black cloud (?) to cover the screen completely due to problems with volumetric light effects.
Added a lot of details to some environments.
Increased a little the exterior fog to improve the atmosphere and help to find your way around the map even with the flashlight off.
Added animation to the skybox.
Improved the quality of some textures and models.
Fixed some minor clipping and popping problems.
Improved stability and general optimization.


Thank you for playing!
